name: ship-pipeline
description: Thirteen repo-agnostic skills for the ship half of the development loop: issue intake, live-schema grounding, evidence-backed verification, report-only slop review, review/PR/merge, production promotion, a batch orchestrator that carries several issues through all of it, and build conventions for API routes, Stripe billing, and PostHog analytics. Every skill detects the repo's own conventions; the shipping-loop skills (start-issue through ship-issues) defer to a repo-local override when one exists.
